GETTING STARTED

Start with a pair of photos.

Use the same simple process to document a desk setup, unplug cables for a move, or keep track of small parts.

1

Create a guide

On Workbench, tap New guide, enter a name, and add a step. You can also explore the included dual-monitor desk example.

2

Photograph and mark

Take or choose a photo of the part and its original position. Tap each image to mark the matching point, then add an action, notes, quantity or bag code.

3

Follow your photos

Tap Start reassembly to review your paired images. Complete each step as you go, or skip one and return to it later.

PHOTO PAIRS

Where did this
cable go?

Use the same code to connect two photos. When it is time to reassemble, look at the cable and switch to the photo of its original port.

Mark the pair

Choose a matching point on each photo.

Zoom in

Switch between photos and use the slider to inspect the details.

Track the bag

Add a quantity and bag code, then find them in the parts index.

right where you left it.

Each project keeps its own steps, photos and progress. Leave when you need to and pick up where you left off.

MORE TOOLS

The details, close at hand.

Use the tools you need to document, resume and share your project.

Camera and voice notes

Capture a part and its original position in sequence. Add an optional voice note to a step and play it back during reassembly.

Widgets and reminders

Add the Refit Home Screen widget to see your current guide and complete a reassembly step. You can also set an optional local reminder.

Export and handoff

Choose Export & handoff to preview and share a PDF. Editable backups include photos and voice notes and can be restored with Import on Workbench.

References and languages

View an interactive parts list or save an HTTPS reference link in a project. The interface supports English, Arabic, Turkish and Spanish.
